description: Report visual enhancement and download support: improve the report_view.html template to render reports with professional visualization (score gauges, tables with colored cells, section cards), and add HTML download button that generates a self-contained HTML file for offline viewing.
steps: In dashboard/templates/report_view.html, enhance the report rendering JavaScript to parse the Markdown report and render it with styled HTML sections: executive summary card with highlighted verdict, score table with color-coded cells (green for bullish, red for bearish), section cards with proper borders and spacing.
Add a 'Download HTML Report' button that uses JavaScript to create a self-contained HTML file (inline CSS + the rendered report content) and triggers a browser download via Blob URL.
Add a 'Download Markdown' button that downloads the raw MD content as a .md file.
Add a 'Copy to Clipboard' button that copies the raw Markdown.
Ensure the report page has proper print styles (@media print) that hide navigation and buttons.
In the report rendering, add visual score gauges: for each agent's score, render a small horizontal bar (CSS only, no JS library needed) showing 0-10 fill with color gradient.
Run: python3 -m pytest tests/ -x -q to confirm no regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Report view page renders with professional styled sections, not raw markdown text
Download HTML button generates a self-contained HTML file
